verificationSummary: A tenth immutable migration persists the unique Owner-to-external-subject binding plus product device and session authentication references without storing bearer token plaintext.
Loopback bootstrap is disabled by default, bounded by expiry, stores only a token digest and atomically permits one Owner binding before becoming permanently unavailable.

The Cloudflare Access verifier accepts only RS256 and validates signature, kid/JWKS rotation, issuer, audience, exp, nbf and bounded clock skew; the stable subject reference is derived from issuer and subject rather than forwarded email or username.
Product sessions and devices persist across repository restart, record activity and recent authentication, and fail closed after session, device or Owner-wide revocation.

Session-bound HMAC CSRF tokens reject expiry and cross-session use; break-glass requires loopback, an independent credential and an exclusive file lock and only exposes mapping repair, session/device revocation or public-ingress disable operations with audit records.
Gateway v2 still applies deterministic authorization after identity verification, so a valid public identity does not bypass ALLOW, ASK or DENY.
